method.clock: (serverTick minus totalPausedTicks) times replay tick interval minus gameStart; use pauseStartTick while paused
method.deathClock: Combat log timestamp minus gameStart; timestampRaw retains pause time and is not substituted
method.deathReference: Same selected hero handle, first lifeState transition from 0 at combat death within 0.1s; illusions and willReincarnate=true excluded
method.positionDiagnostic: Compare nearest replay sample to STRATZ integer time, then separately search same cell within +/-1s; latter is not exact time validation
method.referenceWorld: cell*128+vec-16384, checked against two initial +600 combat-log locations below
method.goldJoin: Original stream order, equal count and every amount; reason correspondence checked separately. No deduplication.
method.csExamples: Match death log by lastHits ordinal and a 2s window, without using XY to select; preserve ambiguity
method.objectiveJoin: Latest decoded state at or before the STRATZ time, per named building handle; match type/team/cell. Initial building records are not kills.
